himself with glory? This is what he says that he shall now do, seeing that Achilles is still
in dudgeon at his ship. We shall get on very well without him if we keep each other in
heart and stand by one another. Now, therefore, let us all do as I say. Let us each take the
best and largest shield we can lay hold of, put on our helmets, and sally forth with our
